mails.outlet: National Trust of Western Australia, Significant Tree Register
mails.subject: Licence for the Significant Tree Register
mails.body:
Hello,

My name is Hidde and I am building ancienttrees.app, a platform for remarkable
trees. My goal is to get people excited about old trees and to encourage them to
go outside and look at them.

I would like to show the trees from your Significant Tree Register on the map,
credited to the National Trust of Western Australia with a link back, starting
with the Perth ones. The register PDF carries no licence, so I am asking rather
than assuming.

The site is free and has no ads, but I am building an app with a paid tier
later, so I will not claim non-commercial. We would only publish trees people
can actually go and see, and we leave out anything in a private garden.

Would you be willing to licence it, or tell me the terms you would want? A
version with coordinates would save me geocoding every address, if one exists.

And either way: which West Australian tree do you think more people should go
and see?

Kind regards,
Hidde
ancienttrees.app
